title: Evidence-backed Task Outcome
outOfScope: Release publication and Japanese capability assessment reserved for WI-16/WI-17.
External Provider identity, CI API, approval, or release mutation.
Adding scores, unsupported efficiency claims, or replacing machine JSON evidence with Markdown.

sources.reason: WI-09 scope, acceptance, and required verification.
Generator behavior and negative claim coverage.

riskAssessment.reason: Outcome reports aggregate governance evidence and can overclaim or leak data if bindings, status, severity, locale, or privacy rules are weak; fail closed on invalid inputs.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution of the approved remediation plan; WI-09 is bounded to local evidence-derived reporting.

preReviewWarnings: Review evidence binding, invalid status/severity rejection, conditional avoided-impact language, privacy redaction, multilingual rendering, and no-score claims.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Outcome JSON and Markdown expose all required sections, including empty-state visibility, without inventing evidence.
Findings, risks, interventions, forced stops, resolutions, recurrence prevention, decisions, verification, and next actions retain traceable evidence bindings.
Invalid bindings/status/severity, duplicate or recurring findings, privacy-sensitive values, unsupported claims, scores, and unconditional avoided-impact claims fail closed.
English, Chinese, and Japanese locale views are deterministic and preserve the same machine evidence; Japanese release capability claims remain out of scope.
Focused outcome/schema tests, full quality, governance checks, and report documentation alignment pass.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Task Outcome artifacts exist, but the reporting boundary must consistently derive human summaries and drill-down detail from events and bound evidence while exposing stops, residual risks, unknowns, and decisions without unsupported claims or privacy leakage.
constraints: Machine-readable JSON remains the source of truth; Markdown, PR, and Status are derived views.
Do not add scores, efficiency, money, time, self-praise, or unconditional avoided-impact claims.
Fail closed on invalid bindings, status, severity, privacy, and unsupported claims.
Keep release publication and Japanese capability evaluation in WI-16/WI-17.
intent.rationale: Evidence-bound reporting lets humans inspect what changed and why a task stopped or completed without confusing a concise summary with proof.

declaredIntent.summary: Enforce evidence-derived Task Outcome JSON/Markdown/report views with traceability, privacy, multilingual consistency, and no unsupported claims.

rawUserRequest: Execute the approved AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation plan serially. For WI-09, complete the evidence-backed Task Outcome Work Item through Contract, implementation, verification, Summary/document alignment, PR, merge, closure, and branch cleanup.

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Empty, minimal, and complete outcomes preserve all required sections and deterministic evidence references.
Invalid binding/status/severity, duplicate/recurring findings, privacy values, scores, and unsupported claims fail closed.
English, Chinese, and Japanese views preserve equivalent machine evidence without making release capability claims.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized serial execution of the complete remediation plan, including evidence-backed reporting and documentation changes.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
